purpose: A CCCS type word on an E card is no VCVS: CCCS and Vs read as control nodes with no DC path, so the deck fails.

oracle.derivation: SPICE E card syntax (ngspice manual, Linear Voltage-Controlled Voltage Sources): E n+ n- nc+ nc- value. Here nc+ = CCCS and nc- = Vs, nodes that touch only the controlling port, which draws no current: they have no DC path to ground and the MNA matrix is singular. Xyce 7.10.0 exits 1 (nodes CCCS and VS "connected to only 1 device terminal"); ngspice-44.2 and 45 exit 1 ("singular matrix: check node cccs").

confirmed.result: ngspice exit 1: DC solution failed - / Warning: singular matrix:  check node cccs; Xyce exit 1: ***** Number of Unknowns = 8 / Netlist warning: Numerically singular matrix found by Amesos, returning zero
